data.summary: The Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against the person for overtaking a lorry despite an overtaking ban and endangering oncoming traffic on 2 October 2026, setting a total amount of €182.00 and one point in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine (Bußgeldbescheid) for a traffic offence. You can accept it and pay once it becomes final, or you may object (Einspruch) in writing or in person with the Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg. The app shows the deadline for filing an objection based on the delivery date shown on the enclosed delivery certificate. If you do nothing, the notice becomes legally binding and the €182.00 must then be paid; consider getting legal advice if you want to contest the facts or the point entered in the Fahreignungsregister.

remedy.period_text: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.
remedy.form_text: Der Einspruch ist beim Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
remedy.quote: Sie können gegen den Bußgeldbescheid Einspruch einlegen.

items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg, or to accept the fine, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the fine notice becomes legally binding (rechtskräftig) and the full amount must be paid.
